question:
Arrange the following in chronological order:

1. GST Council constituted

2. Constitution (101st Amendment) Act enacted

3. GST launched

Choose the correct chronological sequence:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2-1-3**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Goods and Services Tax (GST) was implemented in India on **July 1, 2017**, marking the beginning of a unified indirect tax structure across the nation.
 
• Before its launch, the **Constitution (101st Amendment) Act** was enacted on **September 8, 2016**, to provide the legal framework for GST implementation.
 
• The GST Council, which is responsible for making recommendations on GST-related matters, was constituted on **September 15, 2016**.
 
• Hence, the correct chronological order is as follows:
 
 
• **Constitution (101st Amendment) Act enacted (September 8, 2016)**
 
• **GST Council constituted (September 15, 2016)**
 
• **GST launched (July 1, 2017)**
 
 
 
• This sequence aligns with the preparatory steps taken by the Indian government to roll out GST effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constitution (101st Amendment) Act, 2016:**

 
 
• The 101st Constitutional Amendment was enacted to introduce GST in India.
 
• It empowered both the Centre and the States to levy and collect GST on goods and services.
 
• The amendment subsumed several indirect taxes such as excise duty, service tax, and VAT into a single tax structure.
 
 
 
• **GST Council:**
 
 
• The GST Council is a constitutional body established under Article 279A of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It is chaired by the Union Finance Minister and includes State Finance Ministers as members.
 
• The council is responsible for making recommendations on tax rates, exemptions, and other policy matters related to GST.
